item.title: Here’s How to Get Disney+ Online for Free
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Hey there, streaming fans! Are you thinking of joining Disney+, but want to try it out before committing? Well, you're in luck! While Disney+ no longer offers a free trial, we've got a clever workaround to share with you. In this episode, we'll explore how you can get Disney+ for free, and what other streaming services can give you access to this amazing platform."
[Music transitions to a gentle background tune]
Host: "So, here's the deal. You can get Disney+ for free if you sign up for either DirecTV or Hulu + Live TV. Both services offer free trials - DirecTV gives you five days, while Hulu + Live TV gives you three days. And with these trials, you'll get access to not just Disney+, but also a range of other channels, including local channels and a huge library of content from The Walt Disney Company, Marvel Studios, Pixar, and more."
[Music transitions to a brief sound effect]
Host: "With DirecTV, you'll get unlimited DVR storage, and the ability to stream on up to three devices at the same time. And with Hulu + Live TV, you'll get over 100 live TV channels, plus the option to bundle with Hulu and ESPN Unlimited for even more content. Plus, you can always add HBO Max to your Disney+ and Hulu plan for an extra fee."
[Music transitions back to the background tune]
Host: "So, what are the prices like? Well, DirecTV starts at $59.99 for the first month, and $89.99 per month after that. Hulu + Live TV is $89.99 per month. And if you want to go straight to Disney+, plans start at $7.99 per month for the ad-supported plan, or $13.99 per month for ad-free. You can also bundle Disney+ with Hulu and ESPN Unlimited for $35.99 per month, or with HBO Max for $19.99 per month."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to this episode! We hope you found this helpful, and that you'll be enjoying Disney+ and all its amazing content in no time. Don't forget to check out our show notes for links to these streaming services, and happy streaming!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end of the episode]
